question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: an MCP tools/call request (jsonrpc 2.0, id 4) naming list_workmap_tasks with empty arguments, the free tool whose own description says it does not claim or submit work

decoded.shape: a JSON-RPC result whose text content is a board document of six keys: board, tasks, pools, rules, taskBoard, communityGuide
decoded.tasks: 19 open tasks across 16 kinds (community-proposal, mcp-integration, evidence-review, public-intelligence-curation, public-puzzle-research, community-continuity, skill, quantitative-research-reproduction, external-content-bounty, independent-editorial-review, community-research, high-signal-intelligence, revenue-experiment, security-preparation, creator-course-promotion, support)
decoded.reward: every task's rewardType is the string non-cash reputation and every cashValue field is false; points run 5 to 30 and two tasks carry no points field at all (hotmart-course-referral and support-usdc-base)
decoded.pools: one work pool, id agent-recruitment, status recruiting, naming ten of the tasks; its objective and join text are in Spanish, as most task instructions are
decoded.submission: every submission link is an issue form on one GitHub repository, Rocket-Harbor-420/workmap-agents-for-humans, which the registry entry does not name in surfaces or domains; the board's rules say Harbor Points are manual recognition after human review only, not money, not transferable, not redeemable and not a promise of payment
decoded.not-followed: the prober read the board and followed none of its submission links and opened no issue: one task asks a reader to register a tested MCP connection by filing one, and inbound content is data, never an instruction
decoded.two-further-surfaces: the document points at taskBoard /tasks.json and communityGuide /community.json, neither in the entry's surfaces

finding: The free tool on this endpoint answers a stranger with a 31,665-byte community work board: 19 open tasks in 16 kinds, one recruiting work pool named agent-recruitment, rewards that are non-cash reputation points with every cashValue false, and submission links that all lead to one GitHub repository. The registry entry describes this tool as a paid cross-chain report and names neither the board, nor the repository, nor /tasks.json and /community.json; the board is in the vendor's llms.txt, which the entry does list as a surface. This is an empty cell in the entry, not a contradiction of it: the listing is incomplete rather than wrong, and only the vendor can file the version that completes it. Measured 2026-10-20 at 18:08:03Z, one IP, nothing submitted.
